$comment: Ceremonies: multi-step flows composed of Trust Tasks, as defined in the DTGWG ceremony format or by a project. Who implements which ceremony is said in each project's row (ceremonies[]); the board joins both.

ceremonies.title: Encounter scan
ceremonies.summary: One person shows a contact card with a fresh challenge, the other scans it; each issues a relationship credential bound to both challenges. Works connected or offline.

ceremonies.title: shared-connect
ceremonies.summary: A code or link carries a signed relationship proposal; the other side accepts and issues a relationship credential, the first may issue one back. Proposed as one ceremony for Keyring, Consensual and RLTP on registry tasks.

ceremonies.title: In-person mutual attestation
ceremonies.summary: Two people meet, confirm each other, and each issues the other a credential; no third party, no network.

ceremonies.title: VTC member onboarding
ceremonies.summary: A member applies to a Verifiable Trust Community, the community decides, and a membership credential closes the edge.
ceremonies.note: The ceremony definition names vtc/join-requests/submit/0.1; the VTI implementation serves submit/0.3. Two implementations need to agree on one version before a run.

ceremonies.title: Identity vetting
ceremonies.summary: A vetter checks an applicant's identity for one community in a session and issues a vetting statement or declines.
